summary: Frontend-only verification of ARETION & Company landing page (iteration 2). All 10 explicit acceptance items in the review request PASS. However a high-priority CONTENT bug was discovered: 4 of the 20 consultant cards render the wrong image due to incorrect CSS crop offsets — the consultant's portrait is not visible; instead a non-portrait region of the source sheet is shown (rope bridge, flowers, red 'Emer' sign).

ui_bugs.issue: Card 03 (Bodor Alqaaed) shows a rope bridge image instead of a portrait — crop offset for SHEET_1 col=2 is wrong.
Card 08 (Mona AlMofadda) shows a basket of yellow flowers instead of a portrait — crop offset for SHEET_2 col=3 is wrong.
Card 11 (Mohammed Badawy) shows pink flowers instead of a portrait — crop offset for SHEET_3 col=2 is wrong.
Card 13 (Dr. Naif Mohammad M Harthi) shows a red 'Emer' building sign instead of a portrait — crop offset for SHEET_4 col=0 is wrong.

Root cause: the inline crop math assumes a clean 4-column portrait strip per sheet (left: -(col*250 + 75)% with width:1000%). The actual source screenshots evidently include non-portrait tiles or non-uniform column widths, so columns map to non-face regions for at least 4 cards. Either the per-card 'col' indices need correcting, or per-card x/y offset overrides (or distinct sources) are required.

issues: Some valid portrait crops (e.g. card 01 Bandar Mzahim, card 05 Sharafaldeen Bin Nafisah) are vertically clipped a bit high — the top of the head/ghutra is partly cut. Consider easing the top: -14% offset down to ~-8% for affected sheets or per-card y-offset.

action_items: Fix crop offsets / sources for at least 4 cards displaying non-portrait imagery: card-2 (Bodor Alqaaed, SHEET_1 col=2), card-7 (Mona AlMofadda, SHEET_2 col=3), card-10 (Mohammed Badawy, SHEET_3 col=2), card-12 (Dr. Naif Mohammad M Harthi, SHEET_4 col=0). Recommend either (a) replacing those sheet/col mappings with the correct portrait coordinates, (b) overriding per-card left/top offsets, or (c) using individual portrait URLs per consultant rather than a sheet-crop approach.
Optionally relax top:-14% on .consultant-img to avoid head-top clipping on cards where subjects are framed tighter.
critical_code_review_comments: ConsultantShowcase.jsx hard-codes 5 sheet URLs and assumes uniform 4-column layout — fragile if Emergent CDN changes any sheet. Consider switching to one source per consultant.
LandingPage.jsx runs setInterval(removeBadge, 800) for the lifetime of the page; once removed it could clearInterval after first successful removal to avoid an unnecessary recurring DOM query.
ConsultantShowcase IntersectionObserver correctly unobserves after first trigger — good. The reduced-motion branch is also handled.
All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes — good testability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec acceptance items currently pass on https://healthcare-advisors.preview.emergentagent.com. The remaining work is content/crop correctness: scroll to the consultants grid and visually verify each card shows a portrait of the person named. If main agent re-crops, re-screenshot consultants_full and confirm cards 03, 08, 11, 13 show human portraits matching the labels.
rca of the issue: The CSS-strip-crop technique in ConsultantShowcase.jsx scales each composite screenshot to 1000% width and shifts it left by (col * 250 + 75)% to expose 1 of 4 portraits per sheet. This assumes each sheet image is a uniform 4-column portrait strip. In reality at least four mappings land on non-portrait regions of the source PNGs, producing rope-bridge/flower/sign tiles for cards 2, 7, 10, 12. Fix by either correcting the sheet/col indices in the CONSULTANTS array, supplying per-card left/top overrides, or — preferred — replacing the strip approach with one URL per consultant.
